freeze_type: local hash freeze before training any confirmation victim
development_disclosure: Seeds 202--211 were inspected and are excluded from confirmation. They motivated the frozen SCAn-only branch and support gates.
dataset: GTSRB official 43-class split and frozen 32x32 cache
population: all clean training members plus every added poison copy
detector: pinned upstream BackdoorBench SCAn feature primitive
trusted_reference: deterministic half of official test records in every group
stopping_rule: attempt all ten seeds without replacement or detector, attack, threshold, allocation, or endpoint retuning

pre_scoring_amendments.timing: after victim training began and before any confirmation SCAn score or flag was computed
pre_scoring_amendments.change: the true-policy-pass support-gate count was restricted to eligible victims
pre_scoring_amendments.reason: the written gate concerns qualified victim models; counting an ineligible model would be an implementation error

limitations: The freeze is internally hash-bound without a third-party timestamp.
The development and confirmation blocks share one dataset, architecture, and attack family.
A passed block would not establish cross-architecture or cross-attack generality.
